question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
The Great wall of China was built to link existing fortifications into a united __________ system and to keep the invading Mongol tribes out of China.
options: ecological
irrigation
corporate
defence
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "defence"

Explanation:
☛ The sentence describes the purpose of building 'The Great Wall of China,' which was to unite existing fortifications and prevent invasions by Mongol tribes.
☛ The word 'defence' fits perfectly here as it aligns with the context of protection and military strategy.
☛ Other options like 'ecological,' 'irrigation,' and 'corporate' are irrelevant in this context.
☛ 'Defence system' is a common English phrase referring to a protective arrangement.

Grammar Rules:
☛ Noun Selection: The blank requires a noun before 'system.' 'Defence' is a noun that correctly modifies 'system.'
☛ Context Importance: Understanding the sentence context is crucial. Words like 'fortifications' and 'invading tribes' hint at a security-related answer.
☛ Collocation: 'Defence system' is a standard collocation, whereas other options do not pair naturally with 'system.'
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
The Great wall of China was built to link existing fortifications into a united __________ system and to keep the invading Mongol tribes out of China.
options_hi: ecological
irrigation
corporate
defence
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "defence"

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ वाक्य में 'The Great Wall of China' के निर्माण का उद्देश्य बताया गया है, जो 'existing fortifications' (मौजूदा किलेबंदी) को एकजुट करने और 'invading Mongol tribes' (आक्रमणकारी मंगोल जनजातियों) को रोकने के लिए था।
☛ 'defence' (रक्षा) शब्द इस संदर्भ में सबसे उपयुक्त है क्योंकि यह सुरक्षा और सैन्य उद्देश्यों को दर्शाता है।
☛ अन्य विकल्प जैसे 'ecological' (पारिस्थितिक), 'irrigation' (सिंचाई), और 'corporate' (कॉर्पोरेट) इस वाक्य के संदर्भ में असंगत हैं।
☛ 'defence system' एक सामान्य अंग्रेजी अभिव्यक्ति है जो सुरक्षा व्यवस्था को दर्शाती है।

Grammar Rules:
☛ संज्ञा (Noun) का चयन: रिक्त स्थान पर एक संज्ञा आनी चाहिए जो 'system' से पहले आए। 'Defence' एक संज्ञा है जो 'system' के साथ सही अर्थ देता है।
☛ संदर्भ (Context) की महत्ता: वाक्य के संदर्भ को समझना आवश्यक है। यहाँ 'fortifications' और 'invading tribes' शब्द सुरक्षा/रक्षा का संकेत देते हैं।
☛ Collocation (शब्द-युग्म): 'Defence system' एक सामान्य collocation है, जबकि अन्य विकल्प इसके साथ प्रयोग नहीं किए जाते।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
There ______ been too many incidents of thefts lately.
options: have
was
has
has not
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "have"

Explanation:
☛ The sentence uses 'been', which indicates the present perfect tense.
☛ 'Too many incidents' is a plural noun, so it requires the plural verb 'have'.
☛ 'Was' and 'has' are used with singular subjects, which are not suitable here.
☛ 'Has not' contradicts the meaning of the sentence, as it suggests a lack of theft incidents, while the sentence states their abundance.

Grammar Rules:
☛ The present perfect tense uses 'have/has + past participle (V3)'.
☛ Plural subjects (e.g., 'incidents') take 'have'.
☛ Singular subjects (e.g., 'incident') take 'has'.
☛ While choosing negative forms, the context of the sentence must be considered.
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
There ______ been too many incidents of thefts lately.
options_hi: have
was
has
has not
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "have"

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ वाक्य में 'been' का प्रयोग हुआ है, जो कि present perfect tense का सूचक है।
☛ 'too many incidents' एक बहुवचन संज्ञा (plural noun) है, इसलिए इसके साथ plural verb 'have' का प्रयोग होगा।
☛ 'was' और 'has' का प्रयोग singular subjects के साथ होता है, जो यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं है।
☛ 'has not' वाक्य के अर्थ के विपरीत है, क्योंकि वाक्य में चोरी की घटनाओं की अधिकता बताई गई है।

Grammar Rules:
☛ Present perfect tense में 'have/has + past participle (V3)' का प्रयोग होता है।
☛ Plural subjects (जैसे 'incidents') के साथ 'have' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
☛ Singular subjects (जैसे 'incident') के साथ 'has' का प्रयोग होता है।
☛ Negative forms का चयन करते समय वाक्य के context को ध्यान में रखना चाहिए।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
The tiger looked at me with a serious ________.
options: Smile
Nap
Stare
Wink
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "Stare"


Explanation:
☛ 'Stare' is the correct answer here as it denotes a serious and prolonged gaze, which suits the behavior of a 'tiger'.
☛ 'Smile' and 'Wink' represent human emotions, which are not appropriate for a wild animal.
☛ 'Nap' means to take a short sleep, which doesn't match the context of the sentence.
☛ 'Stare' is a verb that pairs well with 'looked' and gives complete meaning to the sentence.


Grammar Rules:
☛ 'Stare' is an intransitive verb that doesn't require an object.
☛ Here 'with a serious stare' is a prepositional phrase modifying the verb 'looked'.
☛ The adjective 'serious' modifies the noun 'stare', showing correct grammatical structure.
☛ The sentence correctly uses subject (tiger), verb (looked), and prepositional phrase.
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
The tiger looked at me with a serious ________.
options_hi: Smile
Nap

Wink

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ 'Stare' सही उत्तर है क्योंकि यह एक गंभीर और लंबी नज़र को दर्शाता है, जो 'tiger' के व्यवहार के अनुकूल है।
☛ 'Smile' और 'Wink' मानवीय भावनाओं को दर्शाते हैं, जो एक जंगली जानवर के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।
☛ 'Nap' का अर्थ है झपकी लेना, जो वाक्य के संदर्भ से मेल नहीं खाता।

Grammar Rules:
☛ 'Stare' एक intransitive verb है जिसे object की आवश्यकता नहीं होती।
☛ यहाँ 'with a serious stare' prepositional phrase है जो 'looked' की विशेषता बताता है।
☛ Adjective 'serious' noun 'stare' को modify कर रहा है, जो सही grammatical structure दिखाता है।
☛ वाक्य में subject (tiger), verb (looked), और prepositional phrase का सही उपयोग हुआ है।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
His friends disagreed _________ him on that point.
options: on
with
to
for
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "with"

Explanation:
☛ The verb 'disagreed' is used in the sentence, which means 'to have a different opinion'.
☛ In English grammar, the verb 'disagree' is followed by the preposition 'with' when someone disagrees with another person.
☛ Example: "She disagreed with her brother."
☛ Other options like 'on', 'to', and 'for' are incorrect here because they do not collocate correctly with the verb 'disagree'.

Grammar Rules:
☛ The choice of preposition depends on the verb. Certain verbs are always followed by specific prepositions.
☛ 'Disagree' takes 'with', while 'agree' can take 'with' (person) or 'to' (idea).
☛ Examples:
- "I agree with you." (person)
- "I agree to your proposal." (idea)
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
His friends disagreed _________ him on that point.
options_hi: on
with
to
for
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "with"

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ वाक्य में 'disagreed' क्रिया का प्रयोग हुआ है, जिसका अर्थ है 'असहमत होना'।
☛ अंग्रेजी व्याकरण के अनुसार, 'disagree' क्रिया के बाद 'with' preposition का प्रयोग किया जाता है जब कोई व्यक्ति किसी अन्य व्यक्ति से असहमत होता है।
☛ उदाहरण: "She disagreed with her brother."
☛ अन्य विकल्प जैसे 'on', 'to', और 'for' इस संदर्भ में गलत हैं क्योंकि वे 'disagree' क्रिया के साथ सही तालमेल नहीं बिठाते।

Grammar Rules:
☛ Preposition का चयन क्रिया के अनुसार होता है। कुछ क्रियाएँ विशेष prepositions के साथ ही प्रयोग की जाती हैं।
☛ 'Disagree' के साथ 'with' का प्रयोग होता है, जबकि 'agree' के साथ 'with' (व्यक्ति) या 'to' (विचार) का प्रयोग हो सकता है।
☛ उदाहरण:
- "I agree with you." (व्यक्ति)
- "I agree to your proposal." (विचार)

question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
___________ the teacher entered the classroom, all the students stood up to greet him.
options: As soon as
Yet
Whereas
Rather
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "As soon as"

Explanation:
☛ The given sentence describes two events: 'the teacher entered the classroom' and 'all the students stood up to greet him'.
☛ 'As soon as' is used to indicate an immediate relationship between two events, where the second event happens right after the first.
☛ The other options 'Yet' (despite that), 'Whereas' (while), and 'Rather' (instead) are not suitable here as they do not convey immediacy.
☛ 'As soon as' is a conjunction that clarifies the time relationship and provides the correct meaning to the sentence.

Grammar Rules:
☛ 'As soon as' is a subordinating conjunction that connects two clauses and shows a time relationship.
☛ It is mainly used in past and present tenses.
☛ It indicates that one action starts immediately after another action is completed.
☛ Other similar structures include 'Hardly/Scarcely...when' and 'No sooner...than', which also show immediate sequence.
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
___________ the teacher entered the classroom, all the students stood up to greet him.
options_hi: As soon as
Yet
Whereas
Rather
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "As soon as"

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ दिए गए वाक्य में दो घटनाएँ हैं: 'शिक्षक कक्षा में प्रवेश करता है' और 'सभी छात्र उनका अभिवादन करने के लिए खड़े हो जाते हैं'।
☛ 'As soon as' का प्रयोग दो घटनाओं के बीच तत्कालिक संबंध दर्शाने के लिए किया जाता है, जहाँ पहली घटना के होते ही दूसरी घटना घटित होती है।
☛ अन्य विकल्प 'Yet' (फिर भी), 'Whereas' (जबकि), और 'Rather' (बल्कि) इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं हैं क्योंकि वे तत्कालिकता का भाव नहीं देते।
☛ 'As soon as' एक conjunction है जो समय के संबंध को स्पष्ट करता है और वाक्य को सही अर्थ प्रदान करता है।

Grammar Rules:
☛ 'As soon as' एक subordinating conjunction है जो दो clauses को जोड़ता है और समय के संबंध को दर्शाता है।
☛ इसका प्रयोग मुख्यतः past और present tenses में किया जाता है।
☛ यह दर्शाता है कि एक क्रिया के समाप्त होते ही दूसरी क्रिया शुरू हो जाती है।
☛ इसके अलावा, 'Hardly/Scarcely...when' और 'No sooner...than' जैसे structures भी इसी तरह के संबंध को दर्शाते हैं।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
They could not reach the railway station before the train _______.
options: left
has been leaving
has leave
leave
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "left"

Explanation:
☛ The sentence uses the past indefinite tense, indicating a completed action in the past.
☛ 'Could not reach' suggests the action happened in the past, so the second verb must also be in the simple past tense (V2).
☛ 'Left' (V2 of 'leave') is correct here as it agrees with the singular subject 'train' and maintains tense consistency.
☛ Other options are incorrect: 'has been leaving' (present perfect continuous), 'has leave' (grammatically invalid), and 'leave' (base form, incompatible with past tense).

Grammar Rules:
☛ Simple past tense (V2) is used for actions completed at a definite time in the past.
☛ Subject-verb agreement: A singular subject ('train') requires a singular verb ('left').
☛ After modal verbs (e.g., 'could'), the base form of the main verb is used, but here, 'could not reach' is followed by another past event, necessitating the past tense.
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
They could not reach the railway station before the train _______.
options_hi: left
has been leaving
has leave
leave
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "left"

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ वाक्य में past indefinite tense का प्रयोग हुआ है, जिसमें किसी घटना के समाप्त होने का समय निश्चित होता है।
☛ 'Could not reach' से पता चलता है कि यह घटना भूतकाल में हुई है, इसलिए दूसरी क्रिया भी past indefinite (V2) में होनी चाहिए।
☛ 'Left' (V2 of 'leave') यहाँ सही विकल्प है क्योंकि यह simple past tense में है और 'train' के साथ सहमति (agreement) दिखाता है।
☛ अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं: 'has been leaving' (present perfect continuous), 'has leave' (grammatically incorrect), और 'leave' (base form, जो past tense के साथ मेल नहीं खाता)।

Grammar Rules:
☛ Simple past tense (V2) का प्रयोग उन कार्यों के लिए होता है जो भूतकाल में पूर्ण हुए हों।
☛ Subject-verb agreement: Singular subject ('train') के साथ singular verb ('left') का प्रयोग होता है।
☛ Modal verbs (जैसे 'could') के बाद main verb की base form आती है, लेकिन यहाँ 'could not reach' के बाद दूसरी घटना का वर्णन है, इसलिए past tense की आवश्यकता है।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
If you are going to keep eating those cookies, you are going to ________ your dinner.
options: miss
allow
mute
cheer
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "miss"

Explanation:
☛ The sentence is giving a warning that if the person keeps eating cookies, they will miss their dinner.
☛ "Miss" means 'to fail to attend or experience,' which fits perfectly here.
☛ Other options like "allow" (to permit), "mute" (to silence), and "cheer" (to encourage) are irrelevant in this context.
☛ The sentence uses future tense ("are going to"), indicating a probable consequence.

Grammar Rules:
☛ After modal verbs (e.g., 'are going to'), the base form of the verb (miss) is used.
☛ Collocations matter—'miss dinner' is a natural phrase in English.
☛ Always prioritize contextual meaning, as other options make no logical sense here.
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
If you are going to keep eating those cookies, you are going to ________ your dinner.
options_hi: miss
allow
mute
cheer
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "miss"

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ वाक्य में एक चेतावनी दी जा रही है कि यदि व्यक्ति बहुत सारी कुकीज़ खाता रहेगा, तो वह अपना डिनर मिस कर देगा।
☛ "Miss" का अर्थ है 'छूट जाना' या 'नहीं खा पाना', जो इस संदर्भ में सही है।
☛ अन्य विकल्प जैसे "allow" (अनुमति देना), "mute" (आवाज़ बंद करना), और "cheer" (खुश करना) वाक्य के अर्थ के अनुसार उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।
☛ यहाँ future tense का प्रयोग हुआ है, जो एक संभावित परिणाम दर्शाता है।

Grammar Rules:
☛ Modal verbs (जैसे 'are going to') के बाद base form (miss) का प्रयोग होता है।
☛ Collocations (शब्दों का सहज संयोजन) के अनुसार, 'miss dinner' एक सामान्य अभिव्यक्ति है।
☛ Contextual meaning (संदर्भानुसार अर्थ) का ध्यान रखना आवश्यक है, क्योंकि अन्य विकल्प अर्थहीन हो जाते हैं।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
Adult Education is a great step that must be taken by all the countries as it will __________ a lot of issues. The third world countries must especially work to make this happen so they can prosper.
options: permeate
stagnate
resolve
contradict
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "resolve"

Explanation:
☛ The sentence discusses 'Adult Education' and states that it will address many issues.
☛ The word 'resolve' means 'to settle or find a solution,' which fits perfectly in this context.
☛ Other options like 'permeate' (to spread through), 'stagnate' (to become inactive), and 'contradict' (to oppose) do not align with the sentence's meaning.
☛ 'Resolve' is a transitive verb that correctly pairs with the object 'a lot of issues.'

Grammar Rules:
☛ Transitive verbs require an object. Here, 'resolve' takes 'a lot of issues' as its object.
☛ After 'as it will,' the base form of the verb (resolve) is used, which is correct for future tense.
☛ Contextually, 'resolve' is the only word that conveys the idea of solving problems.
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
Adult Education is a great step that must be taken by all the countries as it will __________ a lot of issues. The third world countries must especially work to make this happen so they can prosper.
options_hi: permeate
stagnate
resolve
contradict
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "resolve"

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ वाक्य में 'Adult Education' के बारे में बात की गई है और कहा गया है कि यह कई समस्याओं को हल करेगा।
☛ 'Resolve' शब्द का अर्थ है 'समाधान करना' या 'हल करना', जो इस संदर्भ में पूरी तरह फिट बैठता है।
☛ अन्य विकल्पों में 'permeate' (प्रवेश करना), 'stagnate' (ठहर जाना), और 'contradict' (विरोध करना) का अर्थ वाक्य के संदर्भ से मेल नहीं खाता।
☛ 'Resolve' एक transitive verb है जो 'issues' (समस्याओं) के साथ सही तरीके से जुड़ता है।

Grammar Rules:
☛ Transitive verbs को object की आवश्यकता होती है। यहाँ 'resolve' का object 'a lot of issues' है।
☛ वाक्य में 'as it will' के बाद verb का base form (resolve) आता है, जो future tense में सही है।
☛ Contextual meaning के अनुसार, 'resolve' ही एकमात्र शब्द है जो समस्याओं के समाधान की बात करता है।

question:
Select the most appropriate adverb to fill in the blank.
He is good _________ for the job.
options: rather
altogether
enough
partly
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "enough"

Explanation:
☛ The sentence requires an adverb after the adjective ("good") to indicate its degree or sufficiency.
☛ "Enough" is an adverb that modifies the adjective "good" to convey adequacy.
☛ The other options—"rather" (to some extent), "altogether" (completely), and "partly" (partially)—do not fit the context as they do not express the idea of sufficiency.
☛ Thus, "He is good enough for the job" is the correct sentence, meaning "He meets the required standard for the job."

Grammar Rules:
☛ Adverbs of degree (e.g., "enough," "very," "too") are used to modify adjectives, adverbs, or verbs to show intensity or quantity.
☛ "Enough" is placed after the adjective or adverb it modifies (e.g., "fast enough," "good enough").
☛ Other degree adverbs (e.g., "very," "extremely") are placed before the adjective/adverb (e.g., "very good," "extremely fast").
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate adverb to fill in the blank.
He is good _________ for the job.
options_hi: rather
altogether
enough
partly
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "enough"

Explanation:

question:

question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
A city on a hill ___________ be hidden.
options: need
yet
cannot
ought
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "cannot"

Explanation:
☛ The sentence requires a negative connotation since a city on a hill cannot be hidden.
☛ "Cannot" is a modal verb that expresses inability, which fits the context of the sentence.
☛ Other options like "need" (requirement), "yet" (however), and "ought" (should) do not match the intended meaning.
☛ Modal verbs (can, could, may, might, must, shall, should, will, would, ought to) are used to express different moods such as permission, possibility, necessity, etc.

Grammar Rules:
☛ Modal verbs work with the main verb and take the infinitive form (without "to").
☛ "Cannot" is used to indicate the inability to perform an action. Example: "He cannot drive."
☛ In negative sentences, "not" is added to modal verbs, e.g., "should not," "must not," etc.

question:

☛ Honesty (ईमानदारी) एक सकारात्मक और सार्वभौमिक रूप से स्वीकृत मूल्य है, जो इस वाक्य के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त है।


Grammar Rules:
☛ संज्ञा (Noun) का प्रयोग वाक्य के विषय या वस्तु के रूप में किया जाता है। यहाँ honesty एक अमूर्त संज्ञा (abstract noun) है।
☛ कहावतों (Proverbs) को उनके मूल रूप में ही प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। इनमें शब्दों को बदलने से अर्थ बिगड़ सकता है।
☛ वाक्य में सहायक क्रिया (auxiliary verb) "is" का प्रयोग हुआ है, जो एकवचन संज्ञा के साथ सहमति (agreement) दर्शाता है।
